title: The Locked Library
intro: You wake up on a cold wooden floor inside a locked library. Dust hangs in the air. You see a desk, a bookshelf, a painting, a locked drawer and a heavy door. Next to the door, a keypad sits behind a small metal panel.

messages.not_here: There is nothing like that here.
messages.not_possible: That is not something you can do here.
messages.search_nothing: You search carefully but find nothing new.
messages.win: The keypad beeps. The heavy door swings open and cold fresh air rushes in. You have escaped the library!

help: Type what you want to do in your own words. You can examine things, pick things up, look behind or under things, use an item on something, try a four-digit code on a lock, or ask what you are carrying.

desk.description: A heavy oak desk covered in dust. An old diary lies on top.

bookshelf.description: A tall bookshelf. Four books stand out because they are arranged differently from the others.

books.description: Each of the four books has a handwritten number on its first page. From left to right the numbers are 7, 3, 1, 9.

painting.description: A portrait of a stern man with very watchful eyes. The heavy frame sits slightly away from the wall.
painting.search_text: You lift the heavy frame away from the wall. A small paper scrap is taped to the back of the painting.
painting.search_done_text: Behind the painting there is only the pale square where the paper scrap was taped.

drawer.description: A small wooden drawer under the desk with a four-digit combination lock. It is locked.
drawer.unlock_text: The combination lock clicks and the drawer slides open. Inside you see a brass key and a torn note.

door.description: A heavy oak door. Next to it, a four-digit keypad sits behind a small metal panel that is locked.
door.description_unlocked: A heavy oak door. The metal panel is open and the four-digit keypad is ready.

diary.name: old diary
diary.text: The diary says: "I hid my numbers in four books. Read them in the order they stand on the shelf."

brass_key.name: brass key
brass_key.text: A small brass key, worn smooth. It looks like it would fit a tiny lock.

torn_note.name: torn note
torn_note.text: The note says: "The exit code begins with 48. The rest is hidden behind the eyes of the portrait."

paper_scrap.name: paper scrap
paper_scrap.text: The scrap of paper has just two numbers written on it: 15.
